text: I. Professional Overview Trade economy focuses on "commercial circulation" as its core research object. It mainly explores the entire process of commodity circulation from production to consumption, including market operation mechanisms, trade rules, circulation channel management, and operation of commercial enterprises. It not only pays attention to the organization and regulation of domestic trade but also covers the cross-disciplinary field of integrated domestic and foreign trade, aiming to solve problems such as resource allocation, efficiency improvement, and business model innovation in commercial circulation. It is an important discipline that connects production and consumption. With the development of the digital economy, this major has gradually integrated into emerging fields such as e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce, and new retail, emphasizing the combination of traditional trade and modern information technology.II. Training Objectives This major aims to cultivate applied and multi-skilled talents with a solid foundation in economics and management theories, proficient in the basic principles and operational skills of modern commercial circulation, familiar with domestic trade policies and regulations, market operation rules, and international trade-related knowledge. These talents should be able to work in various commercial enterprises, government commercial management departments, financial institutions, etc., in positions such as market analysis, trade operation, channel management, and policy research. Specific requirements include strong market insight, business practice operation skills, data analysis capabilities, as well as excellent communication, coordination and innovative thinking skills.
